about: Golden stdout, stderr and exit code for every hook entry point over Claude Code payloads. Read by src/test/agent-claude-golden.test.mts. Placeholders: <HOME> and <PROJECT> are the per-case temp home and project, <ROOT> their parent, <REPO> the repository root, <PROJECT_HASH> hashProjectRoot(<PROJECT>). Setup file keys and string values are substituted; an array value is written as JSON lines, an object as JSON. A step env value of null unsets that variable. A Node crash report (an uncaught exception, exit 1) keeps the error and the repository frames: <REPO_URL> is the repository file URL, <LINE>:<COL> and <NODE_VERSION> replace what the runtime decides, and frames outside the repository, the source excerpt and CRLF line ends are dropped.

sources.wiring: Events, matchers and scripts: plugins/continuous-improvement/hooks/hooks.json, generated from src/lib/plugin-metadata.mts:724-760 (inventory: Plugin packaging).
sources.payload_keys: Claude Code snake_case keys session_id, transcript_path, permission_mode, tool_name, tool_input, tool_response, tool_use_id (verified research, Grok entry, which mirrors them as the Claude aliases), plus hook_event_name (session.mts:62-63), cwd (gateguard.mts:78-83), prompt (route-prompt.mts, recall-briefing.mts:155-158) and stop_hook_active (three-section-close.mts:73).
sources.tool_names: Claude tool names Bash, PowerShell, Monitor, Read, Write, Edit, MultiEdit, NotebookEdit and Skill as hardcoded in TOOL_ROUTE / SHELL_TOOLS (gateguard.mts:85-106) and the Skill matcher (companion-preference.mts:193-196). Only names Claude Code emits are used here: a non-Claude tool name belongs in the per-agent fixtures, not in the Claude goldens.
sources.transcript: Stop hooks read the transcript JSONL at transcript_path: the last type 'assistant' row, message.content[] blocks of type 'text' (three-section-close.mts:75-100, goal-drift-stop.mts:101-125).
sources.outputs: Deny: hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision 'deny' JSON at exit 0 (gateguard.mts:441-452, hook-pack.mts:165-168, config-guard.mts:87-90, companion-preference.mts:84-87). Stop block: {decision:'block',reason} (three-section-close.mts:132, goal-drift-stop.mts:185, typecheck-stop.mts:128). Context: hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext (route-prompt.mts:231-234, recall-briefing.mts:129-134, query-cost-nudge.mts:118); SessionStart plain stdout (session.mts:18-23). Allow: empty stdout, exit 0.
